behaviors.description: Update an app while its old deployment remains running and retains its payload.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B app commits and a live holding A sandbox.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary update retains the live A sandbox's payload, installs exact B and preserves the exact runtime, with a newly launched app reporting B.

mappings.rationale: Public enter probes verify that ordinary update retains the live A payload while independent state queries verify exact B and runtime commits and a new launch reports B.
